name: auxiliary_client_extract_content_or_reasoning
notes: Content/reasoning extraction from an LLM response message. REAL src/agent/auxiliary_client.c::auxc_extract_content_or_reasoning linked via extra_src (with link shims for its HTTP/auth surface) against LIVE extract_content_or_reasoning (duck-typed response object). AGREED SUB-CONTRACT (documented, divergent inputs dropped): plain content values and reasoning_content-only fallbacks where the C field-scan agrees with LIVE; '-' encodes an absent payload. KNOWN PORT GAPS (inputs dropped): C does not strip <think> blocks (LIVE cleans them out of content); C does not .strip() the extracted value (padded-content probes diverge on trailing whitespace); C checks 'content' then 'reasoning_content' but never the 'reasoning' field nor reasoning_details (probe {reasoning:'R',reasoning_content:'RC'}: LIVE returns R, C returns RC).
